instruction.name: vpickve2gr.d
instruction.description: Pick the 64-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, sign-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move
experiments.notes: Round trip 5.06 cycles. The vreplgr2vr.d half is 1 cycles (from the memory-assisted decomposition: vrepl-only chain minus vector-store->GPR-load forwarding), so vpickve2gr.d is 4.06 cycles.

latencies.notes: Round trip 5.06 cycles. The vreplgr2vr.d half is 1 cycles (from the memory-assisted decomposition: vrepl-only chain minus vector-store->GPR-load forwarding), so vpickve2gr.d is 4.06 cycles. Nominal values: round-trip core cycles rounded to the nearest integer.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vpickve2gr.d $r12, $vr8, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r13, $vr9, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r14, $vr10, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r15, $vr11, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r16, $vr12, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r17, $vr13, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r18, $vr14, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r19, $vr15, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vpickve2gr.d $r12, $vr8, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r13, $vr9, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r14, $vr10, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r15, $vr11, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r16, $vr12, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r17, $vr13, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r18, $vr14, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r19, $vr15, 0'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 7.99 cycles. Counter 0xfb is normalised per instruction. The measured CPI 0.9988 is the nominal 1 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LSX two-uop instruction. Individual latency is not separable without a round trip through the reverse move; throughput is measured with 8 independent lanes. Extra counter 0xfb records the classified uop count.
